decisions.reason: As a homepage-promoted launch that builds directly on the firm's core cloud messaging offer and stated growth direction, management is likely to justify the investment and continue backing it.

Document capture and recognition extends the firm's electronic document workflow logic, and with visible standalone presentation plus ongoing R&D, management is likely to give it more time rather than reverse course quickly.
Although only lightly publicized, email and fax conversion fits the firm's multichannel communications base, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

This is less central and only presented as a feature, but because it is close to the established fax-related business and inexpensive to maintain relative to a full new platform, management would likely retain it.
Security is central to the firm's value proposition for regulated customers, so even with limited public visibility management would tend to persist with this protection service.

Multi-engine virus scanning is adjacent to the core secure messaging offer and supports the firm's reliability claims, so management is more likely to keep and refine it than to admit an early retreat.
